guarantees.claim: threshold_hit_q is cleared to 0 on reset (rst_ni low) or when threshold_hit_clr is high; set to 1 when threshold_hit is high and threshold_hit_clr is not high; otherwise retains previous value.
guarantees.cond: always at posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni

assumptions.claim: threshold_hit_clr must be deasserted (low) before a new threshold_hit event arrives to ensure the hit is captured into threshold_hit_q.
assumptions.cond: when the system intends to detect threshold_hit events
assumptions.risk: If threshold_hit_clr is held high or asserted coincident with threshold_hit, threshold_hit_q stays 0, dropping the event and potentially hiding an entropy health failure.

uncertain_points.claim: Unclear whether simultaneous threshold_hit and threshold_hit_clr should result in cleared hit (current behavior) or should prioritize capturing the hit.
uncertain_points.cond: when both threshold_hit and threshold_hit_clr are active in the same cycle
uncertain_points.risk: If the design intent is to prioritize hit over clear, current behavior leads to missed threshold events.

uncertain_points.claim: If threshold_hit_clr is asserted for multiple cycles, all threshold_hit events occurring during that window are lost, and threshold_hit_q remains low.
uncertain_points.cond: when threshold_hit_clr remains high for more than one cycle
uncertain_points.risk: Consecutive threshold hits may be undetected, undermining entropy health monitoring.
